windowOpenedNotice.result: Approval window win-1 is open for 30 minutes (minutes) until 2026-01-01T00:30:00.000Z, opened from Operator proposal op-3. Inside it the controller approves Operator command proposals and answers worker prompts with an option that asks once, without asking the user. It never picks an option that widens permissions, types text or presses Esc. It does not answer non-file tool prompts. These always need the user, even inside the window: git push --force; @controller-restart. The floor is not a sandbox; scripts and shells are approved unchecked during a window. It ends at its time cap, when it is revoked or replaced, or when the controller restarts.
